title: Norwegian Salmon Skewers with Indian Spices
description: A fusion dish of Norwegian salmon and Indian spices, perfect for a summer evening. The delicate flavor of the salmon pairs well with the bold spices.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and salt. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, and the spice paste. Add the salmon pieces and mix well to coat.
Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated salmon onto the pre-soaked skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of naan or rice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and lemon wedges, if desired.
